stage: G28 frozen-I joint C/W2 numerical control
scope: Reuse frozen learned I. No new structure search. Learner receives no teacher C/W2. This does not validate extraction with unknown readout.

pattern.policy: Same old 0110 support/query/test. Joint Adam on C, common hidden b, output b and readout. Identical paired C/-C branch budget for both heads. Select each checkpoint/start/rate on query BCE only. Free head has eight independent parameters. Head L2 is mean square, matching scalar-head scale.

sets.policy: Simultaneous damped Gauss-Newton on C and readout, fresh signed starts. For each function, half the free-head starts begin with equal coefficients, half with independent random coefficients. Known b stays fixed. Observed f(0) anchors an unknown output offset. All predictors frozen before test. Pooled head groups inferred only from learned I column signatures. Fully free head has 16 independent coefficients/output; permutation invariance is audited, not assumed.
sets.matrix_task: Two outputs with a new learned 2x2 matrix after pooling the two local feature channels, expanded across eight points. New Gaussian C and signed matrices. This teacher remains a set function; no unknown-readout structure extraction is performed.

resource_policy: Only GPUs0-3, packed numerical starts; never6/7 or foreign4/5.
pre_fit_recovery: Preparation wrote and froze all data, then failed only while converting a relative bookkeeping path. Path normalized; code snapshot refreshed before any fitting. Data untouched.
